name: Timed wait demo
description: Demonstrate a complete Sendero with five agents that wait progressively longer at each position.

edges.name: begin demo
edges.objective: Start with the one-minute wait agent.

edges.name: continue to two minutes
edges.objective: After waiting one minute, continue to the two-minute wait agent.

edges.name: continue to three minutes
edges.objective: After waiting two minutes, continue to the three-minute wait agent.

edges.name: continue to four minutes
edges.objective: After waiting three minutes, continue to the four-minute wait agent.

edges.name: continue to five minutes
edges.objective: After waiting four minutes, continue to the five-minute wait agent.

edges.name: complete demo
edges.objective: After waiting five minutes, complete the demo.
